name: quill-claude-extension
description: Private, on-device access to your Quill meetings, minutes, transcripts, notes, contacts, and threads.
long_description: Connect Claude to Quill to get access to your meetings, minutes, transcripts, notes, contacts, and threads. Use it to quickly surface decisions and action items, draft follow-ups, and pull context into docs and CRMs. Runs entirely on your device and communicates with Quill via a local protocol—no cloud upload.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Get a single meeting by id

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Search or list meetings by text query and/or filter by participants, tags, or date

tools.name: get_minutes
tools.description: Return the latest AI-generated minutes for a meeting

tools.name: search_minutes
tools.description: Full-text search inside AI-generated minutes across meetings

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Return the meeting transcript with speakers and timestamps (very long; prefer minutes first)

tools.name: get_private_notes
tools.description: Return the notes the user typed by hand during a meeting

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Fetch the image for one or more screenshots referenced in a transcript

tools.name: list_notes

tools.name: get_note

tools.name: update_note

tools.name: add_to_dictionary

tools.name: update_contact

tools.name: add_contact_observation

tools.name: list_threads
